def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # template rows: more than one nonzero
    templates=[row for row in g if sum(1 for x in row if x)>1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        if sum(1 for x in row if x)>1: continue
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v==0: continue
            src=None
            for t in templates:
                if v in t: src=t; break
            if src is None: continue
            j=src.index(v); shift=c-j
            for cc in range(w):
                k=cc-shift
                if 0<=k<w and src[k]!=0: out[r][cc]=src[k]
    return out

print(transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
res=transform(G['Test input'])
import json; print(json.dumps(res))

import json
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # template blocks: contiguous nonzero runs in rows with >1 nonzero
    blocks=[]
    for row in g:
        if sum(1 for x in row if x)>1:
            c=0
            while c<w:
                if row[c]!=0:
                    c2=c
                    while c2<w and row[c2]!=0: c2+=1
                    blocks.append((c,row[c:c2]))
                    c=c2
                else: c+=1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        if sum(1 for x in row if x)>1: continue
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v==0: continue
            blk=None
            for s,b in blocks:
                if v in b: blk=(s,b); break
            if blk is None: continue
            s,b=blk; j=b.index(v); shift=c-j-s
            for k in range(len(b)):
                cc=s+shift+k
                if 0<=cc<w: out[r][cc]=b[k]
    return out
